## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The exclusion flag should honor the required environment default so CI can configure it without changing its command line.

## Changes

The pull request adds and documents a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters files by basename and logs skipped paths in verbose mode. It adds tests for argument parsing, file collection and archive contents.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE='*.log'` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser supplies `[]`, so `skip.log` enters the archive. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires that “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure archive options through environment variables cannot use the new exclusion flag.
